intuition: Reverse the water rule: from each ocean, move uphill or level to find cells that can drain into it.

brute_force.approach: For each cell, search downhill to each ocean boundary.

optimal.approach: Run reverse reachability from both ocean borders and intersect the reachable sets.

edge_cases: The same cell may reach both oceans.
Only move to neighbors at least as high as the current reverse-search cell.
